title: Create Custom Jerseys (2026)
verdict: The easiest way to create custom jerseys in 2026 is Wooter's builder. Pick a sport and a style, change the colors, logo and team name, add the roster, and the preview and price update as you go.

If you would rather not design at all, Wooter's designers do it free. Custom Ink's Design Lab fits a printed, tee-style jersey. Boombah's builders are strong for baseball, softball and basketball. Champro and Nike Team have builders too, but the order goes through a dealer.

ranking.fit: Anyone who wants to design a full team set online and see the price before committing.
ranking.lacks: The design is instant. Delivery is not: production takes two to four weeks.

ranking.fit: Groups creating a printed jersey from a template or an uploaded logo.
ranking.lacks: You are decorating a stock garment, so the cut and panels are fixed.

ranking.fit: Baseball, softball and basketball teams that want to build a sublimated uniform online.
ranking.lacks: Lead times and minimums differ from page to page on its site.

ranking.fit: Coaches who want to build a design and hand it to their dealer.
ranking.lacks: The builder saves a design. A dealer account places the order.

ranking.fit: Programs designing a Nike uniform with their dealer.

why: Creating a jersey comes down to four decisions: the sport and cut, the design, the roster, and the date you need it. A good builder walks you through them in that order.
On Wooter you start from 500+ styles, edit the colors and add your logo, then enter each player's name, number, size and quantity. Rosters copy between products, so shorts and warmups take a minute.
Stuck on the design? Send your ideas and a Wooter designer builds it at no charge, usually in 1 to 2 business days. You pay only when you place the order.

criteria.name: Live preview
criteria.text: You see the jersey change as you edit.

criteria.name: Price while you design
criteria.text: No quote request to find out the cost.

criteria.name: Roster handling
criteria.text: Names, numbers and sizes per player.

criteria.name: Free design help
criteria.text: A designer who takes over when you are stuck.

criteria.name: Who places the order
criteria.text: You at a checkout, or a dealer on your behalf.

faq.q: Can I create a jersey with no design skills?
faq.a: Yes. Start from a finished style and change the colors, or skip the builder and ask Wooter's designers to do it for free.

faq.q: What file do I need for my logo?
faq.a: A vector file is best. A clean PNG is enough to start with.

faq.q: How many jerseys do I have to order?
faq.a: It depends on the product. Wooter's catalog lists minimums by item, some starting at one. Check the product page before planning a small order.

faq.q: How long after I design it do the jerseys arrive?
faq.a: Two to four weeks from order to delivery at Wooter.

faq.q: Can one design go on every item?
faq.a: Yes. On Wooter the same design can run across jerseys, shorts, hoodies, jackets and bags.
